notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.24.4
Aperture Flux Normalization is new: SASpro's own local normalization matches every registered frame to the whole set region by region, building a brightness map from the stars themselves so thin cloud, haze and wide-field extinction are corrected where they actually dimmed the frame, then matching sky glow with the target cancelled out of the comparison. Each frame earns only as much detail as its held-out stars support, it works with drizzle, and it is off by default in Stacking Settings. Drizzle now honors frame weights in Register and Integrate (every frame was being deposited at full weight, including ones weighting had dropped), the square kernel drops the exact rotated pixel, and GPU drizzle is up to 60x faster per frame. Normalization now scales across all your cores instead of stopping at eight, with RCD debayering 3-4x faster per frame. Checkpoint Save / Export gains every format option Save As has, Save As never downgrades the open image to the bit depth of a JPEG or other lower-depth copy, Curves gets Undo Apply and uses less memory, and the Blink Comparator grades each frame against its group and pre-flags only the clear rejects. Around 30 tools now give their memory back when they close. See the release notes for the full list.
